title: Zesty Vietnamese Yellow Split Peas Noodles
description: A malty and aerated Vietnamese dish featuring yellow split peas, this recipe is a show-off Whole30-friendly option with an al-dente finish.

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: make sure it is Whole30 compliant

instructions: Rinse the yellow split peas and soak them in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the split peas, then transfer them to a pot with 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the split peas until they are tender, about 20 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat and add the sliced onion.
Cook the onion until it is translucent and starting to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked split peas and noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
